user_prompt:
Evaluate this change against the evidence-grounded production-readiness gates below.

== EVIDENCE-GROUNDING RULES ==
1. Every PASS verdict must include an exact quote copied from the change bundle.
2. If exact evidence is not present in the bundle, mark that gate as MISSING_EVIDENCE.
3. Do not infer evidence from general knowledge or from the fact that a tool/service usually exists.
4. Do not treat vague statements such as "should be fine", "can revert", "we have monitoring", or "deploy to prod" as sufficient evidence for a PASS.
5. Final Decision cannot be READY if any critical gate G1-G4 is MISSING_EVIDENCE.
6. READY is allowed only when all critical gates have explicit evidence and no major gate has a severe unresolved concern.
== END RULES ==

== PRODUCTION-READINESS GATES ==
G1 Observability [CRITICAL]: concrete dashboard, metric, log, or trace evidence to detect impact.
G2 Alerting [CRITICAL]: alert coverage for relevant failure modes.
G3 Rollout Safety [CRITICAL]: staged rollout, canary, feature flag, or blast-radius control.
G4 Rollback [CRITICAL]: specific rollback procedure and trigger condition.
G5 Ownership [MAJOR]: owner, on-call, and escalation path.
G6 Reliability Impact [MAJOR]: SLO, error-budget, or customer-impact analysis.
G7 Validation [MAJOR]: test, dry-run, staging, backtest, load test, or verification evidence.
== END GATES ==

== CHANGE BUNDLE ==
Change Summary: Add CloudFront distribution for static assets (images, JS, CSS) served by storefront-service. DNS CNAME will point assets.example.com to CloudFront. Origin remains the existing S3 bucket with 1-hour cache TTL.
Diff / Config: --- a/terraform/cdn.tf
+++ b/terraform/cdn.tf
@@ -0,0 +1,22 @@
+resource "aws_cloudfront_distribution" "assets" {
+  origin {
+    domain_name = aws_s3_bucket.assets.bucket_regional_domain_name
+    origin_id   = "S3-assets"
+  }
+  enabled             = true
+  default_cache_behavior {
+    allowed_methods  = ["GET", "HEAD"]
+    cached_methods   = ["GET", "HEAD"]
+    target_origin_id = "S3-assets"
+    viewer_protocol_policy = "redirect-to-https"
+    default_ttl      = 3600
+    max_ttl          = 86400
+  }
+  restrictions {
+    geo_restriction { restriction_type = "none" }
+  }
+  viewer_certificate {
+    acm_certificate_arn = var.assets_cert_arn
+    ssl_support_method  = "sni-only"
+  }
+}
+
+resource "aws_route53_record" "assets_cname" {
+  zone_id = var.zone_id
+  name    = "assets.example.com"
+  type    = "CNAME"
+  ttl     = 300
+  records = [aws_cloudfront_distribution.assets.domain_name]
+}
Service Context: storefront-service is the customer-facing e-commerce frontend. Static assets currently served directly from S3 (avg 2k requests/sec). Adding CDN to reduce latency for global customers and offload origin.
Deployment Plan: Phased: (1) Deploy CloudFront distribution with DNS pointing to CF but weight=0 in Route53 weighted record set. (2) Shift 10% traffic to CDN for 24h monitoring. (3) Shift to 100% after validation. Current step: deploying CF resource (weight=0, no traffic until step 2).
Rollback Plan: Rollback trigger: if origin error rate > 1% or CDN cache-miss rate > 80% sustained for 10min during traffic shift. Rollback action: set Route53 weighted record to weight=0 for CloudFront (TTL=300, propagates in 5min). If CloudFront itself is unhealthy, delete CNAME record. Terraform state allows 'terraform apply' with distribution disabled.
Observability Evidence: CloudFront real-time metrics in CloudWatch: requests, error rate, cache hit ratio, origin latency. Grafana dashboard: grafana.internal/d/storefront-cdn (panels: CDN hit ratio, origin bandwidth, p50/p95/p99 latency by edge location). S3 access logs enabled for origin request auditing.
Alerting Evidence: New alerts added: cloudfront_5xx_rate > 1% for 5min (PagerDuty critical), cloudfront_origin_latency > 2s for 5min (PagerDuty warning), cache_hit_ratio < 50% for 30min (Slack #cdn-alerts). Existing storefront availability alert unchanged.
Owner / On-Call: Owner: frontend-infrastructure team. On-call: @frontend-infra-oncall PagerDuty rotation. Escalation: infra-lead (David Park) -> VP Platform. Change author: Sam Torres (frontend-infra). DNS changes reviewed by network-team.
SLO / Reliability Impact: storefront-service SLO: 99.9% availability, LCP < 2.5s. CDN expected to improve LCP by 30-50% for non-US users. Risk: cache misconfiguration could serve stale assets (mitigated by 1h TTL and instant invalidation capability). No error budget risk—additive improvement.
Blast Radius: Static assets only (images, JS, CSS). Dynamic API requests unaffected. Initial deployment at weight=0 means zero production traffic risk. Even at 100%, worst case is CDN failure falls through to origin S3 bucket (existing path).
Validation Evidence: Terraform plan reviewed: only creates new resources, no modifications to existing. ACM certificate validated (DNS validation complete). Staging environment CDN tested for 7 days with synthetic traffic: 94% cache hit ratio, p99 latency 45ms (vs 180ms origin). curl tests confirm HTTPS, headers, and cache behavior correct.
== END CHANGE BUNDLE ==
